result.rationale: The diff changes group-members.js.es6 setupController from the previous afterModel pattern (which returned the findMembers promise so the route could handle failure) to a bare `model.findMembers();` with no rejection handling. If the ajax call rejects, no members are set and the members table iterates `{{#each m in members}}` with an empty list, showing zero members with no error surfaced. This is a real behavioral regression introduced by the diff.

adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/discourse/routes/group-members.js.es6`, `setupController` now calls `model.findMembers();` as fire-and-forget and does not return/chain the promise or handle rejection. `findMembers()` performs an Ajax request and only sets `members` on success. The template `app/assets/javascripts/discourse/templates/group/members.hbs` was changed to iterate `{{#each m in members}}`, so if the request fails (or never resolves), `members` remains unset and the page will render no rows with no route-level error handling triggered by the returned promise (since nothing is returned from `setupController`). This is a diff-grounded behavior regression compared to the prior `afterModel` that returned the promise.
